overview:
**High fire danger today, driven by low humidity (24%) and elevated energy release (ERC 86%), with the outlook rising to Very High by midweek.**
- Danger climbs through the week: ERC and BI percentiles trend upward daily, reaching Very High fire danger by Thursday (Aug 27) and staying there through the weekend.
- Winds shift from light ENE (7 mph) today to steadier NE gusts up to 14 mph by Sunday, adding to drying conditions.
- Only 1 of 7 local watchout thresholds is currently met (low afternoon humidity); no Red Flag Warning or NWS alerts are active, though a slight afternoon storm chance persists today.
- Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests moved from Stage 2 to Stage 1 fire restrictions on August 20; Gunnison County itself remains in Stage 2 restrictions (no open burning).
- Nearby: the Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray is at 39,718 acres and 87% contained, with area/road closures and energy infrastructure still threatened; the Elk Fire on the GMUG is 7,257 acres and 33% contained, with command transferring back to the local unit today.
